proposals.before: In the fourth month of Zhide 3 she was enfeoffed as empress. The text read: "Qian is heaven and Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang and the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.
proposals.after: In the fourth month of Zhida 3 she was enfeoffed as empress. The text read: "Qian is heaven and Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang and the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.
proposals.reason: Chinese 至大 is Zhida, not Zhide.

proposals.before: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhide she was enfeoffed as empress; the text read: "Qian is heaven, Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang, the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.
proposals.after: In the fourth month of the third year of Zhida she was enfeoffed as empress; the text read: "Qian is heaven, Kun is earth; the four seasons thereby achieve mutual completion; the sun honors yang, the moon honors yin; the ten thousand images thereby all appear together.
proposals.reason: Chinese 至大 is Zhida, not Zhide.

proposals.before: Empress Sugabala was the daughter of Ochen Harqishi and a cousin of Empress Zhenge on her mother's side.
proposals.after: Empress Sugabala was the daughter of Ochen Harqishi and a cousin of Empress Zhenge.
proposals.reason: 從妹 is a younger female cousin (typically paternal-line), not specifically maternal; idiomatic already omits the wrong maternal gloss.

proposals.before: Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, a niece by marriage of Chengzong.
proposals.after: Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, a niece of Chengzong.
proposals.reason: 甥 denotes a sibling's child, not a niece by marriage.

proposals.before: Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, Chengzong's niece by marriage.
proposals.after: Empress Babusha was the daughter of Princess Shouning, Chengzong's niece.
proposals.reason: 甥 denotes a sibling's child, not a niece by marriage.

proposals.before: She died in the eighth month of Zhiping 25, aged forty-two.
proposals.after: She died in the eighth month of Zhizheng 25, aged forty-two.
proposals.reason: Chinese 至正 is Zhizheng, not Zhiping.

proposals.before: She died in the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of Zhiping, aged forty-two.
proposals.after: She died in the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of Zhizheng, aged forty-two.
proposals.reason: Chinese 至正 is Zhizheng, not Zhiping.

proposals.before: After more than a month the crown prince returned from Jining and wept for her with great grief.
proposals.after: After more than a month the crown prince returned from Ji'ning and wept for her with great grief.
proposals.reason: 冀寧 (Ji'ning Circuit) is distinct from 濟寧 (Jining); keep the apostrophe to avoid conflation.

proposals.before: After more than a month the crown prince returned from Jining and wept for her with great grief.
proposals.after: After more than a month the crown prince returned from Ji'ning and wept for her with great grief.
proposals.reason: 冀寧 should not be collapsed with 濟寧 Jining.

proposals.before: At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Xuanhui Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Emperor Shun.
proposals.after: At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Huizheng Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Emperor Shun.
proposals.reason: 徽政院 is the Huizheng Court, not the Xuanhui Court (宣徽院).

proposals.before: At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Xuanhui Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Shundi.
proposals.after: At first Tumen Die'er, commissioner of the Huizheng Court, presented her as a palace woman in charge of serving tea; she attended Shundi.
proposals.reason: 徽政院 is the Huizheng Court, not the Xuanhui Court (宣徽院).

proposals.before: When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Xuanhui Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.
proposals.after: When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Huizheng Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.
proposals.reason: 徽政院 is Huizheng, not Xuanhui (宣徽).

proposals.before: When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Xuanhui Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.
proposals.after: When Bayan was dismissed from the chancellorship, Sharaban then requested that she be established as second empress; she dwelt in Xingsheng Palace, and the Huizheng Court was renamed the Zizheng Court.

proposals.before: In Zhiping 18 there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.
proposals.after: In Zhizheng 18 there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.
proposals.reason: 至正 is Zhizheng, not Zhiping.

proposals.before: In the eighteenth year of Zhiping there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.
proposals.after: In the eighteenth year of Zhizheng there was great famine in the capital; the empress ordered officials to provide gruel for the people to eat.

proposals.before: At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Toqto'a, who did not reply.
proposals.after: At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Taiping, who did not reply.
proposals.reason: 丞相太平 is Chancellor Taiping, not Toqto'a (脫脫).

proposals.before: At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Toqto'a; Toqto'a did not reply.
proposals.after: At that time the emperor was rather slack in government; the empress and Crown Prince Ayushiridara hastily plotted an inner abdication and sent Po Buhua to convey their intent to Chancellor Taiping; Taiping did not reply.
proposals.reason: 丞相太平 is Chancellor Taiping, not Toqto'a (脫脫).

proposals.before: They again summoned Toqto'a to the palace, raised wine and bestowed it on him, and personally renewed the former request; Toqto'a only hesitated and equivocated, and therefore the empress and the crown prince bore resentment against him.
proposals.after: They again summoned Taiping to the palace, raised wine and bestowed it on him, and personally renewed the former request; Taiping only hesitated and equivocated, and therefore the empress and the crown prince bore resentment against him.
proposals.reason: 太平 is Taiping, not Toqto'a.

decisions.reason: s0099 has 至大三年四月; 至大 is the Yuan era Zhida, not Zhide, so the proposed idiomatic correctly restores the reign title.
The same Chinese 至大三年四月 shows literal Zhide is wrong; Zhida matches 至大.
s0108 has 真哥皇后之從妹也; 從妹 is a younger female cousin and does not mark a maternal-line relation, so removing on her mother's side is required.
s0154 has 成宗甥壽寧公主; 甥 is a sibling's child, not a niece by marriage, so niece of Chengzong is the accurate repair.
The same 成宗甥 shows literal niece by marriage invents affinity; Chengzong's niece restores the kinship term.
s0225 has 至正二十五年八月; 至正 is Zhizheng, not Zhiping.
The same Chinese 至正二十五年八月 confirms literal must read Zhizheng, not Zhiping.
s0228 has 自冀寧歸; 冀寧 is distinct from 濟寧, and Ji'ning correctly blocks conflation with Jining.
The same 冀寧 shows literal Jining collapses two different place-names; Ji'ning is the needed disambiguation.
s0231 has 徽政院使; 徽政院 is the Huizheng Court, not 宣徽院 Xuanhui Court.
The same 徽政院使 shows literal Xuanhui Court is a wrong office name; Huizheng Court matches the Chinese.
s0235 has 改徽政院為資正院; the renamed body is the Huizheng Court, not the Xuanhui Court.
The same 改徽政院為資正院 confirms literal must replace Xuanhui with Huizheng.
s0238 has 至正十八年; 至正 is Zhizheng, not Zhiping.
The same 至正十八年 shows literal Zhiping is wrong; Zhizheng is required.
s0240 has 丞相太平，太平不答; 太平 is Taiping, not 脫脫 Toqto'a.
The same 丞相太平，太平不答 shows literal Toqto'a invents a different chancellor; Taiping matches the Chinese.
s0241 has 復召太平至宮…太平依違而已; both mentions are 太平 Taiping, not Toqto'a.
The same 復召太平至宮 and 太平依違而已 confirm literal must read Taiping throughout.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 復召太平至宮，舉酒賜之，自申前請，太平依違而已

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0016/r0017/r0018/r0019 show English Toqto'a came only from mistranslating 太平; the personal-name claim must read Taiping while keeping zh, pinyin, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
